**বাংলায়:** পুরো চেকলিস্টের প্রতিটা গ্রুপ আপনার ঠিক করা সময়ে staging-এ পরীক্ষা হয়, ফল AI সেকশনে; নিজে কিছু ঠিক করে না; শুরুতে বন্ধ

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-01
  - Build status row: the checklist audit (After launch, batch 4; B7.3; settings `health.audit`, off): `docs/qa/audit-checklist.json` (448 points in 24 groups) and `audit-groups.json`; `audit.yml` on the VM runs the smoke test and the journeys with every UI check on the owner's schedule and judges each group; AI › Checklist audit (`/admin/ai/audit`); fixes only through Fixes to approve (PR 420)

- **What it does (original scope):** **Checklist audit runner in the AI section.** The full e-commerce checklist (qa/ECOMMERCE-CHECKLIST.md, 405 points, grouped and prioritised) lives in the backend. One click → 2–3 agents test the chosen groups on desktop and several phones; or a schedule (e.g. weekly) with the report and bug list sent to Telegram. The owner controls when, how many agents and which groups. Fixes only with his permission.
- **Filed under:** [S21 addition — checklist audit runner (owner, 19 Oct, round 15 note 17)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#s21-addition--checklist-audit-runner-owner-19-oct-round-15-note-17)

  - **20 Oct** · [Scope added to existing PRs (V2.1 final · 20 Oct — pre-code demo work finished; blueprint V2.1 final; no new PR numbers)](../MASTER-REGISTER.md#how-this-reached-624): **PR 42 / 570 (slider engine, audit runner)** — the timing rules proven in TA-2 (530 checks, 0 fails; checklist L32/L33): separate pause flags for mouse, touch and keyboard; every pause has a tested resume path; sliders resume within about 100 ms after the mouse leaves, after a drag and after a sideways wheel; a vertical wheel is ignored by sliders; every row drags with the mouse and a click after a drag doesn't open the card; the toast holds on hover and focus; timers are cleared on route change; focus returns to the opener when a menu or panel closes; a cancelled pull-to-refresh resets. ## PR 594

**PR register inside the backend (owner, 19 Oct 14:59)**

**বাংলায়:** README আর রেজিস্টার না মিললে CI থামিয়ে দেয়; ডিপ্লয়ের সময় সব ডকুমেন্ট সার্ভারে যায়।

**Details**

- **Status:** In demo (not built yet)
  - GitHub pull request #44, 24 Oct
  - GitHub pull request #20, 20 Oct
  - GitHub pull request #19, 20 Oct
- **What it does (original scope):** **PR register inside the backend (owner, 19 Oct 14:59)** — an admin section listing every stage and every PR with its full details (what it does, scope added later and when, owner decision, status: built / parked / in demo / in code / live, owning agent, demo page link). Click a PR for the full card; search and filters; history of updates per PR (date, round, note); "report a problem on this PR" so the owner can point to an exact PR when something breaks — it opens a task for the owning agent via the chief. Generated from the master register on every build, so new PRs appear automatically; nothing typed twice. **Also holds the latest full blueprint .md (highest version marked latest), the master register and the supporting files** (round notes, plans, research, checklist, QA reports, agent protocol) — read inside the admin with contents and search, downloadable, with version history per file; backed up to Google Drive with everything else; no personal data, no third-party skill copies.
